It also notes the constraint that Belimo has limited reach to individual buyers through its B2B model. It does not surface a non-obvious option or correct a false premise beyond this, so it stops short of 3.

How OEM channels would preserve Belimo's margin is also unexplained, so the chain is incomplete.
